ref: ADR-0006 Consequences, createIf (amended with #133, F-37): "" is no boolean and raises po:CREATEIF at the createIf box, observed in #31 for an empty source value (corpus/observations/obs-target-creation/po75/probe-bool-c-spec2-create-if-row.txt); assumed until obs-target-creation-2 (#134) answers: the same for the "" another createIf gives
note: createIf(createIf(Tag)) with Tag true, false, 1 in context Orders. The inner createIf C1 gives "", SUPPRESS, ""; the outer one C2 casts "", which is no boolean, so the run raises po:CREATEIF at C2. Taking "" as false would write the root empty, as true two All.
